title: Recent Developments in Urban Studies; Community Visioning with Foresight
description: The accelerated pace of change and increased uncertainty about the future make it ever more difficult to plan for the future of a community. Creating a resilient community vision requires knowledge about potentialdrivers of change and a nimble process that allows planners to pivot while the future is approaching. This course will be an introduction to how planners can use the concept of foresight in community visioning. Foresight is an approach that aims at making sense of the future, understanding drivers of change that are outside of one'scontrol, and preparing for what may lead to success or failure in the future. Students will learn about foresight methodologies, including participatory trend scanning, scenario planning, and backcasting, and how to use them in a community visioning process. As part of the course, the students will create a community vision for a community of their choice, applying these methodologies.
